turns.question: What was the average number of customer service calls per day in September 2026, counting days with no calls as zero?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for average calls per day, so I cannot give that figure; the closest metrics are Calls labelled (calls_labelled), which counted 32 calls in total from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, and its breakdowns such as Calls with an objection and Positive calls. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
